evals.name: training-plan-ambiguous-menopause-split-asymmetry
evals.prompt: ok new client starting monday — Denise Okafor, 52, 5'6", 141 lbs. styku from friday: body fat 33.8%, lean mass 87.4 lbs (62.0%), fat mass 47.6 (33.8%), bone mass 6.0 (4.3%), BMI 22.8, BMR 1342, shape score 68/100 good, VFA 88.4, ALST index 5.41. arms L 6.9 R 6.1, legs L 14.2 R 15.0. she says her cycle has been all over the place this past year and she's getting night sweats, but nothing confirmed with her doctor. tested her last week: hex DL 115x5, goblet squat 45x8, seated DB press 15x5 per hand, incline DB 20x5 per hand, push ups 12, farmer carry 30/hand for 40s, hip thrust 95x5, plank 1:10. no pull ups yet. she can do 3 days, tue/thu/sat. build her plan
evals.expected_output: scripts/denise_okafor_3day_plan.js plus trainer .docx and Client View .docx in clients/denise_okafor/, audited clean
